# Shock impact and recovery

In this section, we harmonize, for each of the 17 shocks of Rmd 16, how hard it hit the household and how far it has recovered. These are the questions behind WFP's ability-to-recover indicator, asked in the 2021 annual survey, the 2022 annual survey and the two 2023 rounds, of households that experienced the shock in the last 12 months.

* **Impact** on food consumption and on income: 1 = no impact, 2 = slight decrease, 3 = strong decrease, 4 = worse than ever. Don't know (5 in 2021 and 2022, 888 in 2023) becomes 888; refusals (6, 8888) become missing. The 2021 annual survey asked the income question only for floods, drought and the death of a household member.
* **Recovery:** the ability to meet food needs now, and expected in a year, compared with before the shock: 1 = worse, 2 = the same, 3 = better.
* **The columns are located by position, not by name.** In the 2021 annual survey the questions on crop diseases, crop pests and weeds are all named after weeds (`...MauvaisesHerb`, `...MauvaisesHerb1`, `...MauvaisesHerb2`), and later rounds spell the income question three ways. The workbook takes the questions that follow each shock's 12-month question.
* **Answers without the shock are removed.** In the 2021 annual file, theft (food impact and both recovery questions) and the death of a member (recovery in a year) hold answers for nearly every household, about 1,130 to 1,350 of them without that shock. These questions follow the shock, so only the answers of households that experienced it in the last 12 months are kept.

```{r 28 packages needed}
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r 28 remove environment variables}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r 28 environment settings}
dir_input_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/input_data/Chad"
dir_output_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/output_data/Chad"
```

```{r 28 read harmonization excel file}
Chad_Harmonization_variables <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module == "ShockImpact")
Chad_Harmonization_description <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
Chad_Harmonization_ID <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NewVariable_Name == "ID")
```

```{r 28 data importation}
lst_data = Chad_Harmonization_description$Data
lst_test = Chad_Harmonization_description$Name
for (i in 1:length(lst_data)) {
  assign(lst_test[i], read_sav(paste0(dir_input_data, "/", lst_data[i])))
}
```

```{r 28 select and rename columns needed}
for (j in 1:length(lst_test)) {
  raw <- get(lst_test[j], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- tibble::tibble(.rows = nrow(raw))
  id_var <- Chad_Harmonization_ID[[lst_test[j]]]
  df$ID <- if (is.na(id_var)) NA_character_ else { z <- zap_labels(raw[[id_var]]); if (is.numeric(z)) format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) else as.character(z) }
  for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) {
    v <- Chad_Harmonization_variables[[lst_test[j]]][i]
    df[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]] <- if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(zap_labels(raw[[v]]))
  }
  df$round_name <- lst_test[j]
  assign(lst_test[j], df)
}
Chad_pdm_2022$ID = as.character(1:nrow(Chad_pdm_2022))
```

## Recoding

```{r}
vars <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name
impact <- grep("^ShkImp", vars, value = TRUE); recovery <- grep("^ShkRec", vars, value = TRUE)
df_Chad <- dplyr::bind_rows(mget(lst_test))
y2023 <- df_Chad$round_name %in% c("Chad_pdm_2023", "Chad_ea_2023")
for (v in impact) {
  x <- df_Chad[[v]]
  stopifnot(all(x[!y2023] %in% c(1:6, NA)), all(x[y2023] %in% c(1:4, 888, 8888, NA)))
  dk <- (x == 5 & !y2023) | (x == 888 & y2023); refused <- (x == 6 & !y2023) | (x == 8888 & y2023)
  x[dk %in% TRUE] <- 888; x[refused %in% TRUE] <- NA
  df_Chad[[v]] <- x
}
for (v in recovery) stopifnot(all(df_Chad[[v]] %in% c(1:3, NA)))
# Asked only after the shock: no answer without a shock in the last 12 months
shocks <- zap_labels(read_dta(paste0(dir_output_data, "/WFP_Chad_Shocks.dta")))
j <- match(df_Chad$ID, as.character(shocks$ID))
# In the 2021 annual file, theft (food impact, both recovery questions) and the death of a member (recovery in a
# year) hold answers for nearly every household, including those without the shock. They cannot have been asked:
# answers are kept only where the household experienced the shock in the last 12 months.
for (s in sub("^ShkImpFood_", "", grep("^ShkImpFood_", vars, value = TRUE))) for (k in c("ShkImpFood_", "ShkImpInc_", "ShkRecNow_", "ShkRec1y_")) {
  v <- paste0(k, s); bad <- !is.na(df_Chad[[v]]) & !(shocks[[paste0("Shk12m_", s)]][j] %in% 1)
  if (sum(bad)) print(c(v, table(df_Chad$round_name[bad])))
  df_Chad[[v]][bad] <- NA
}
```

```{r}
for (v in impact) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("No impact" = 1, "Slight decrease" = 2, "Strong decrease" = 3, "Worse than ever" = 4, "Don't know" = 888))
for (v in recovery) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("Worse than before the shock" = 1, "Same as before the shock" = 2, "Better than before the shock" = 3))
for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) var_label(df_Chad[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]]) <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$Label[i]
var_label(df_Chad$ID) <- "Household ID"
```

## Export all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- df_Chad %>% dplyr::select(ID, all_of(vars))
haven::write_dta(df_Chad, paste0(dir_output_data, "/", "WFP_Chad_ShockImpact.dta"))
```
